title: Nosto - Costly for smaller merchants, narrow personalization focus
clean_text: Nosto can be costly for smaller merchants and sometimes requires technical setup expertise despite being marketed as accessible. Its focus is primarily on product-level personalization rather than broader behavioral insights or survey-based feedback, prompting some merchants to evaluate alternatives offering different approaches. Pricing negotiations require presenting historical transaction counts and competing quotes to secure favorable terms, and auto-renewal clauses are a common point of contention for new customers.
